problem: Pi v13 reserved a final search and opened both known regressions, but its repair queries copied an unsupported exact answer or even a refusal sentence instead of the unresolved question constraint. Both regressions stayed wrong, one known improvement was unnecessarily repaired, and only one of three known improvements survived.
simplest_baseline: Pi v13 deterministically searches the extracted exact answer plus a generic biography suffix, or the first relation terms for a year answer.
hypothesis: A schema-constrained non-thinking query planner that sees the original question, unsupported draft, typed audit reasons, and failed repair query will produce one obligation-grounded counter-query whose top-20 retrieval contains gold evidence on at least two of the three open calibration cases, without changing the retriever or search budget.
anti_claim: This is a frozen-model harness query-allocation experiment, not training and not a model-capability improvement.

framework_comparisons.current_gap: DeerFlow exposes broad failure replay and dynamic delegation; this loop isolates one saved late-stage evidence obligation and measures whether exactly one replacement query changes retrieval before rerunning synthesis.

relevant_mechanisms: Deep Research Bench export and cost reporting
framework_comparisons.current_gap: Its phase separation supports a dedicated repair-planning boundary, while its official README does not make claim-level failed-query replay the evaluation unit.
Its planner improves broad coverage; the measured failure is narrower: transform one typed unsupported answer obligation into one auditable replacement query under the same search cap.
Parallel query expansion could hide a weak query by spending more searches; this loop first requires one replacement query to beat the saved failed query at identical top-20 retrieval cost.

frozen_controls: deepseek-v4-flash with thinking disabled for repair-query planning
one top-20 retrieval per calibration case
saved v13 question, draft audit, and failed repair query
no answer synthesis during retrieval calibration
next_action: Start a new bridge-hypothesis loop: first preserve a post-hoc oracle showing whether one missing domain, geography, or topic bridge can make the frozen retriever hit gold, then test forced contrastive hypotheses rather than another unconstrained query rewrite.
claim_boundary: The three cases and their gold evidence were observed before this loop. They can calibrate query mechanics only and cannot support effectiveness, leaderboard, or model-capability claims.
